scope.historicalModel: Humbert2011 Table3 joined by Gronlund2015 with reported WHO-age-standard combined78 DALY/kg inhaled; all-age intake denominator, selected adult cardiopulmonary/lung cancer outcomes.
scope.unitEmissionBasis: Separate one-kg normalization of each named flow; no equal service or actual product inventory is assumed.
scope.mixtureBasis: Consistency calculation from displayed height-specific factors and displayed source shares; height-specific fine factors themselves derived from an unknown-height anchor. Not independent model validation.
scope.modernContrast: Four published Australia Ground_level emission-group factors in GLAM V1.0.2024.10; source-side Urban/Rural and Average/Marginal scenarios, impacts summed over receptors. No mixing with historical effect factor.
